title: Padilla visits UC Irvine to spotlight research and innovation
snippet: U.S. Sen. Alex Padilla visited UC Irvine to learn how university research is driving innovation. Errol Arkilic, UC Irvine's chief innovation officer, highlighted the university's infrastructure for turning research discoveries, including artificial intelligence, into products and services.

title: Innovator's Journey
snippet: The Greater Irvine Chamber's premier innovation event, Innovator's Journey, featured keynote speaker Errol Arkilic, Chief Innovation Officer at UC Irvine. The event explored the complete innovation lifecycle and featured discussions on responsible AI and emerging technologies.

title: AI Frontiers: Education, FinTech & India's R&D Future
snippet: GIFT International FinTech Institute (GIFT IFI) hosted 'AI Frontiers: Education, FinTech & India's R&D Future' featuring Dr. Rajesh Gupta, Founding Dean of the School of Computing, Information and Data Sciences (SCIDS) at UC San Diego, alongside other UCSD professors to discuss emerging AI and FinTech innovations.

title: Success Doesn't Mean Slowing Down | ft. Dr. Safiya Noble
snippet: In this episode of B The Way Forward, host Brenda Darden Wilkerson sits down with Dr. Safiya Umoja Noble, author of Algorithms of Oppression. They discuss algorithmic bias, how AI is deepening the educational divide, and why retreat is a luxury we cannot afford.

title: From our network and alumni: Karina Zambani
snippet: Karina Zambani, a research intern with Data x Direction and the Society, Ethics & Technology group, now serves on the University of California AI Steering Committee, which works alongside the UC AI Council on responsible AI across the ten-campus system.
